text.description_html:
First Impressions AP-PCF150SBR, 1-1/2" Pacific Acrylic Refrigerator Handle

The 1-1/2 Inch Acrylic Appliance Door Pull can be used all over your kitchen from the refrigerator to the freezer an even the dishwasher. It comes packaged with bolts that work with any standard appliance door panel. The handle is made from high-quality acrylic that keeps it looking beautiful even in direct sunlight. Choose from clear or frosted acrylic in 18 inch, 24 inch, or 36 inch sizes. The mounts are made from solid brass and because of that, they are available in a huge selection of finishes so you can coordinate the pulls with the other hardware in your kitchen.

Specifications for the First Impressions AP-PCF150SBR Acrylic Fridge Handle:

  • Pull Handle Material: Clear or Frosted Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thru-Bolts
  • First Impressions AP-PCF150SBR Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 3 Sizes:

    FII-AP-PCF150018SBR:
    • Total Length: 18"
    • Center to Center Mount: 12"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/4"

    FII-AP-PCF150024SBR:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/4"

    FII-AP-PCF150036SBR:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 24"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1-1/2"
    • Total Projection: 3-1/4"

Note: This door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it— it can be custom designed to fit your specific door application in lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold Individually
